EXTRA: The test asserts that charge('2.665') equals '2.67', but the cited requirement specifies that halfway amounts round away from zero (e.g., "2.675" becomes "2.68"). The value 2.665 is not halfway between two hundredths (it is closer to 2.66 than 2.67), so this test case does not correspond to the stated requirement.
